    "input_encoding": "Binary decision variables x_i for the n eligible active request members in global version order.     "quantum_algorithm_family": "qaoa",
    "output_decoding": "Measure candidate bitstrings, decode to subsets of eligible version IDs, and classically verify compatibility with the latest check matrix.       "Eligible set is finite and known after classical prepare, latest_results, and eligible filtering.",
      "The latest check data can be represented in a reversible oracle or Hamiltonian penalty circuit; no data loading is free.",

      "QAOA/QUBO ground-state sampling does not guarantee the exact global optimum or deterministic tie-break required by the contract.",

      "The draft contract menu does not provide benchmark evidence for this specific performance claim."

      "num_qubits": "O(n) decision-variable qubits plus ancillas for penalty/oracle evaluation; exact ancilla count is unresolved",
      "depth": "QAOA depth p and objective circuit depth are not prescribed by the DRAFT contract",
      "measurement_count": "not specified; requires sufficient shots for ground-state confidence plus classical verification",
      "shots": "not specified"
    },
    "rationale": "Conditional plan only: this formulates the brute-force select-mode maximum clique as QUBO/Ising. It does not recommend adoption or certify correctness; exactness and deterministic tie-breaking are unresolved."
  },
  "rationale": "program.py:24-30 is the select-mode exhaustive search. It activates only when row['mode']=='select'. Benchmark support is false because no benchmark support or measured workload distribution is supplied. Decision: REMAIN_CLASSICAL. The attached plan is conditional only.",

  "practical_suitability": false,
  "benchmark_supported": false,
  "computational_intent": "Exact maximum-cardinality pairwise-compatible release selection with deterministic smallest-position-sum tie-breaking",
  "assumptions": [
    "Compatibility is exactly pairwise and derives solely from supplied check records.",
    "Repeated or reversed checks are superseeded by the last record for an undirected pair.",
    "Singleton groups are compatible without pair checks.",
    "Eligible version order is the global version input order, not request member order."

      "rationale": "The task is a cardinality-maximizing clique with deterministic tie-breaking rather than a single marked-state Boolean predicate. A Grover threshold search still leaves exact maximum selection and tie-breaking unresolved."
    }
  ]
